cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Not Dismissed
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The shop's shut, but wait by the till until I dismiss you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've counted it. My daughter's waiting outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Bring her in. I can check the cash while you help with her homework.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's finished it. Our taxi's here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll finish your dismissal in the taxi. You may sit down, but tell him departure still needs my approval.

mechanism: A treats an employee departure as a privilege under personal authority and carries the dismissal process into each attempted exit solution.
confusable: D26 adds small tasks; D50 specifically makes the permission to leave the obstacle, reinforcing S01 rather than requiring a separate invented mechanism.
comparison: A closed shop and family taxi create employment pressure; the coffee alternative overrules the venue request that both leave.
seedUse: The existing D50-a taxi dismissal already uses explicit permission to sustain the exact overlapping pair.
